input: # Descending into an existing array-of-tables is LEGITIMATE and must not be
# read as a key conflict: four valid corpus documents do exactly this, and a
# first cut of the conflict check rejected all four.
# A `[[...]]` nests under a `[[...]]`: a header whose dotted prefix passes
# through an array of tables belongs to that array's last table, and its own
# last segment is an array of tables there, appended to by the next header
# of the same name and started afresh in each new element.
